# Narasimha Skill Sphere — Comprehensive Information & Curriculum Reference

> Tagline: Learning-By-Doing

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Vision

Narasimha Skill Sphere Private Limited is an educational innovation company founded in Bihar, India. The company works directly with schools, institutions, colleges, and young learners to transform traditional memorization-based education into experiential, hands-on STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) excellence.

The organization is formally recognized under:
- Startup India (DPIIT - Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade)
- Startup Bihar (Department of Industries, Govt. of Bihar)
- MSME (Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt. of India)
- Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) / NITI Aayog ecosystem
- ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Standard

---

## 2. Institutional School Partnerships & ATL Lab Setup

Narasimha Skill Sphere partners with schools to implement turnkey STEM & Innovation Labs:
- **Atal Tinkering Lab (ATL) Setup**: Full compliance with NITI Aayog guidelines, including complete lab layout, workbench equipment, 3D printers, electronics workbenches, drone testing cages, and robotic kits.
- **NEP 2020 Aligned Curriculum**: Standardized weekly lesson plans from Grade 1 to 12 blending experiential science, coding, and design thinking.
- **Certified Full-time / Part-time STEM Mentors**: Providing trained instructors to manage labs, run daily sessions, and mentor student projects.
- **Faculty Development Programs (FDP)**: Upskilling school teachers to adopt activity-based learning and troubleshoot hardware toolkits.
- **Annual Robotics Exhibitions & Hackathons**: Organizing inter-school competitions, science fairs, and community showcases.

---

## 3. Patna Innovation Center (Direct Student Program)

Located in Kankarbagh, Patna, this flagship center provides weekend (Saturday-Sunday) and after-school interactive tracks:
- **Student-to-Kit Ratio**: 1:1 or 2:1 hands-on hardware access.
- **Trial Classes**: Free personalized assessment and trial workshop for students and parents.
- **Capstone Portfolios**: Every student builds real working prototypes (e.g., obstacle-avoiding cars, automatic irrigation systems, gesture-controlled rovers, mini-drones) and receives verified project certificates.

---

## 4. Comprehensive Course Tracks

### Track A: Block Coding & Logical Reasoning (Grades 1–4)
- Algorithmic thinking using visual drag-and-drop environments (Scratch, Blockly).
- Event handling, loops, conditionals, variables, sound synthesis, and interactive storytelling.
- Building mini games, digital animations, and introductory logic games.

### Track B: Starter Robotics & Basic Electronics (Grades 3–6)
- Circuits, breadboards, LEDs, resistors, DC motors, servo motors, buzzer modules, and switches.
- Modular robotic chassis assembly, mechanical gear ratios, wheel traction, and battery management.
- Hands-on line-follower robots, light-activated rovers, and sound-triggered machines.

### Track C: Microcontrollers & Arduino C++ (Grades 5–8)
- Arduino Uno/Nano microcontroller architecture, digital & analog I/O pins, PWM signals.
- Writing embedded C/C++ in Arduino IDE: Serial monitor debugging, sensor calibration.
- Interfacing ultrasonic distance sensors, IR sensors, PIR motion detectors, and LCD displays.
- Ultrasonic obstacle-avoiding rovers and Bluetooth remote-controlled cars.

### Track D: Internet of Things (IoT) & Smart Systems (Grades 7–10)
- ESP8266 and ESP32 Wi-Fi/Bluetooth microcontrollers.
- Cloud platforms (Blynk, Adafruit IO, MQTT protocol), HTTP web servers on microcontrollers.
- Home automation: smart lighting, remote temperature monitoring, water-level indicators.

### Track E: Python Programming & Applied AI (Grades 7–12)
- Core Python syntax: data types, functions, object-oriented concepts, and modules.
- Computer vision with OpenCV: face detection, color tracking, hand gesture recognition.
- Intro to Machine Learning: train classifiers using Teachable Machine and Python scikit-learn.
- Voice-assisted smart bots, automated attendance cameras, and predictive analytics.

### Track F: 3D Design & 3D Printing (Grades 5–12)
- 3D spatial thinking, CAD modeling with Tinkercad and Autodesk Fusion 360.
- Slicing software (UltiMaker Cura), infill density, print speeds, layer heights, support structures.
- FDM 3D printer operation, PLA filament handling, rapid prototyping for robotic parts.

### Track G: Drones & Aeronautics (Grades 8–12)
- Aerodynamics, quadcopter physics, lift, thrust, pitch, roll, and yaw.
- Frame assembly, brushless DC motors, Electronic Speed Controllers (ESCs), flight controllers.
- Safe flying simulation, transmitter binding, PID tuning, and autonomous waypoint navigation.
